description: Admin-only: enable/pause global polling or set intervalMinutes from 1 to 1440 (default 10). Requires a production key issued to an administrator, directly or through OAuth with the admin scope. Legacy keys cannot control global polling. Enabling may resume already authorized autosend across workspaces. Preserves active scheduler leases; does not invoke the worker immediately.
name: update_email_letter_polling
title: Update Email Letter Polling
